subject: Picnic details
text: Hi there, I wanted to share the final details for the community picnic next Saturday so you can plan around it. It begins at noon on the east side of Riverside Park, near the playground, and the covered tables will be easy to spot from the path. Bring a side dish if you can, but nothing elaborate is needed. If possible, a vegetarian side and a dessert would help, since we have salads and fruit. I will provide drinks and plates. We still need two people to bring folding chairs from my garage; I started setting them aside this morning and did not finish loading them. I will leave them by the side door, labeled with the table number, but if the boxes are not ready please let me know before nine so someone can help move them quickly. The main plan is simple: arrive, grab a place, and enjoy the afternoon.
